title: varronia duartei
intro: Varronia duartei, commonly known as "erva-preta" or "black bush", is a medicinal plant native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The leaves and roots of Varronia duartei have been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Varronia duartei include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and alleviate digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Varronia duartei include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its potential health benefits.
